papers.title: Mechanism of heat treatment regulation on the formation of Ti-6Al-4V oxide film in additive manufacturing and its corrosion resistance: Synergistic effect of matrix structure and residual stress
papers.first_author_affiliation: Key Laboratory for Ecological Metallurgy of Multimetallic Mineral (Ministry of Education), Northeastern University, Shenyang 110819, China

corresponding_authors.name: Jianzhong Li
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Key Laboratory for Ecological Metallurgy of Multimetallic Mineral (Ministry of Education), Northeastern University, Shenyang 110819, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文涉及增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的热处理，但主要关注氧化膜和耐腐蚀性，而非疲劳或力学性能，与预期方向部分相关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper investigates corrosion resistance rather than fatigue or mechanical performance, which is the primary focus of this direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热处理对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V氧化膜形成及耐腐蚀性的调控机制。
summary_zh.method: 表征不同热处理条件下氧化膜结构与厚度，并通过电化学测试评价耐腐蚀性。
summary_zh.result: 热处理通过协同改变基体结构和残余应力影响氧化膜形成及耐腐蚀性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验表征与电化学测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the mechanism by which heat treatment regulates oxide film formation and corrosion resistance of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Characterized oxide film structure and thickness under different heat treatment conditions and evaluated corrosion resistance via electrochemical tests.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment synergistically influences oxide film formation and corrosion resistance through modification of matrix structure and residual stress.
